        matrix = GSLMatrix(self.matrix.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.c_double), self.n, self.n)
        lu_decomp(matrix, self.perm, None, None)
        return matrix, self.perm, self.signum

class gsl_matrix(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('data', ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)), ('size', (c_int, c_int))] 

class gsl_permutation(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [('data', ctypes.POINTER(c_int)), ('size', c_int)]

def cholesky_decomposition(input_matrix):
    # Allocate and initialize GSL data structures
    rows, cols = len(input_matrix), len(input_matrix[0])
    mat = gsl_matrix(data=ctypes.cast(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)(*[(i, j) for i in range(rows) for j in range(cols)])), size=(rows, cols))
    perm = gsl_permutation(data=ctypes.cast(ctypes.POINTER(c_int)(*[i for i in range(rows)]), c_void_p), size=rows)

    # Set matrix values from Python input
    for i in range(rows):

    status = gsl_linalg_pcholesky_decomp(mat, rows, perm, ctypes.cast(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)(*[(0 for _ in range(rows))]), c_void_p))

    modified_matrix = [[mat.data[i * cols + j] for j in range(cols)] for i in range(rows)]
    permutation = [perm.data[i] for i in range(rows)]
    return modified_matrix, permutation

def brent_minimize(func, x_lower, x_upper, initial_guess):
    
    # Define function pointer types
    func_ptr = gsl.gsl_function_type()
    wrapped_func = gsl.gsl_function_type(ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double))
    
    # Wrap the Python function in a C compatible function
    def wrapped_func(x):
        return func(x)
    
    # Set up GSL function structure
    func_ptr.function = wrapped_func
    func_ptr.params = None
    
    # Define minimum finding parameters
    minimum_result = gsl.gsl_root_fdfmin()
    minimum_result.x = (ctypes.c_double * 2)()  
    minimum_result.xmin = ctypes.c_double(initial_guess)
    minimum_result.fval = ctypes.c_double()
    minimum_result.upper = ctypes.c_double(x_upper)
    minimum_result.lower = ctypes.c_double(x_lower)

    # Find minimum using brent's method
    minimum_found = gsl.gsl_root_fdfmin_brent(func_ptr, minimum_result, 1e-6, 1e-6)
    if minimum_found == 0:
        return minimum_result.xmin.value, minimum_result.fval.value
    else:
        return None, None
